summary: Provides a daily report of fee collections, specifically excluding admission heads. It includes miscellaneous heads and regular fee heads.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Daily Fee Report
business_rules: Admission heads are NOT shown in this report.
Miscellaneous heads and other income heads (if configured in fee setup) are shown.
important_notes: The key difference from "Combined Daily Collection" is the exclusion of admission heads.
questions: Where can I see daily fee collections excluding admission fees?
What is the difference between the Daily Fee Report and Combined Daily Collection?
